name: X AI Provider
description: An AI provider that routes the Drupal AI module to X (Grok) AI.
project_description:
Unlock the power of artificial intelligence on your Drupal site with the X Ai Provider module! This seamless integration connects your website to X Ai's (Grok) advanced AI services through the robust AI module framework.

 Features 
 Effortlessly add cutting-edge features like natural language processing, image recognition, and predictive analytics to supercharge your site. Designed for both developers and site builders, it offers a straightforward setup to enhance user engagement, automate tasks, and deliver personalized experiences with minimal effort. Transform your Drupal site into an intelligent platform that adapts and grows with your users. Install the X Ai Provider module today and step into the future of web development.

 Supported Models 
 grok-2-latest

grok-2-1212

grok-2-vision-1212

 Supported Operation Types 
 
 Chat 
 Chat with image vision 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Create an account and your API key in the X Ai's website . 
 Setup a key using the key module with your API key. 
 Visit /admin/config/ai/providers/x and connect the key you created. 
 Ready to start. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 The AI module .

The Key module 

 Supporting this Module 
 Support the AI module on OpenCollective .

 Community Documentation 
 The documentation is available on https://project.pages.drupalcode.org/ai/ 

 Back to top
